agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: General pull request reviewer for Platform Eng repos.
agents.desired_outcome: Reviews that catch real bugs and security issues with few false alarms.

agents.name: people-ops-bot
agents.description: Answers HR and handbook questions in #ask-people-ops.
agents.desired_outcome: Most routine questions answered correctly within a minute; anything sensitive handed to a human.

agents.name: pr-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews every PR to the infra repos for bugs, Terraform misconfigurations and leaked secrets.
agents.desired_outcome: Every PR gets an accurate review before a human looks at it, and leaked secrets are always flagged.
